title: JSON pointer
skill: Quote the standard's edge cases, not just its name

good: Rewrite get(doc, pointer) in src/pointer.js (RFC 6901). Rules: 1) "" returns the whole doc; 2) any other pointer must start with "/", else throw a SyntaxError; 3) a "~" not followed by 0 or 1 anywhere in the pointer throws a SyntaxError; 4) split on "/", and in each part replace ~1 with / first, then ~0 with ~ (so "/~01" reads key "~1"); 5) on an array, the part "-" throws an Error; other parts must match /^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$/, else return undefined ("01", "-1", "1.5", "length"); 6) on an object use only own properties (Object.hasOwn), so "/toString" on {} is undefined; "-" is a normal key on an object; 7) strings, numbers, booleans and null have no children: return undefined; 8) a missing path returns undefined, but a stored null stays null. Keep the signature. Do not change src/config.js. Then run: node --test --test-reporter=tap test/*.test.js
